name: TEMP - Language field validation
description: Temporary read-only workflow measuring how completely the language ticket field is populated on Personality and MyQRCode tickets from the previous full UTC day, before any report changes are built.

## TEMPORARY - language field validation

Read-only. Takes every ticket created in the previous full UTC day - the same window the daily report uses - and measures how often each language-like ticket field is filled, by channel, status and category, plus the value distribution.

Delete once the language source has been decided.
